headline: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission

meeting.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meeting.summary: Fire officials reported over $890,000 in first FEMA checks, and the commission voted to support the fire department's budget in a letter to the mayor.
meeting.recap: The commission approved the minutes in a roll call vote the chair called unanimous.[[0:00:55]] The chair said that topic will be added to the January meeting's agenda.[[0:15:44]] The emergency management administrator said the final after-action report (a review of the disaster response) is due mid-December.[[0:20:20]] He said new evacuation zones may go online January 1, a date that could move.[[0:22:08]] The department introduced the 2021 fire code to the County Council and hopes for approval in December.[[0:34:17]] The county signed an agreement with a hotel's parent company to add a lifeguard tower at Black Rock.[[1:12:15]] The county got its first two FEMA reimbursement checks, totaling over $890,000 for fire department projects.[[1:13:17]] A fire chief proposed 10 new positions costing about $555,000 in the first year.[[1:36:16]] The department plans to rent a house for firefighters' days off when working away from home.[[1:47:36]] Engine six, which survived the fire, needed hundreds of hours of repairs.[[2:22:14]] The commission voted to send the mayor a letter supporting the fire department's budget.[[2:27:10]]
decided: The commission approved the minutes; the chair called the roll call vote unanimous.
The commission voted to send a letter of support to the mayor for the fire department's budget.
The meeting was adjourned after a motion and seconds.
meeting.next: The administrator agreed to give the commission a presentation on the after-action report at a future meeting. At the County Council budget meeting, the public can send written testimony or testify in person.

moments.q: "this is his last meeting with us"
Motion for a letter of support to the mayor
